title: Pete
style: emotional folk rock, 90 BPM, acoustic guitar lead, raw honest male vocal NZ/AU accent, brother theme, protective bond, simple direct lyrics, no vocal effects, breath audible, silence as punctuation, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Pete pulled me out
That's the whole story
No ceremony
No moment of glory

Just hands in the water
Just a brother who looked
Just the right second
In the right overlooked

[CHORUS]
Pete
You don't know what you did
Pete
I was almost a name they never said
Pete
I owe you a lifetime
Pete
You were just a kid

[VERSE 2]
Now he runs the boats
Indian Ocean — steady hand
Sixty-two feet of vessel
The same hands on command

It doesn't need explaining
The bond doesn't bend
He pulled me from the water
He is where it ends

[BRIDGE — spoken]
There are no coincidences.
There are no heroic moments.
There are just brothers
who look at the right time.

[CHORUS]
Pete
You don't know what you did
Pete
I was almost a name they never said
Pete
I owe you a lifetime
Pete
You were just a kid

[OUTRO]
You were just a kid.
You were just a kid.
